hooks.command:
SOCOM="$(command -v socom 2>/dev/null)"
[ -z "$SOCOM" ] && [ -n "$SOCOM_HOME" ] && [ -x "$SOCOM_HOME/bin/socom" ] && SOCOM="$SOCOM_HOME/bin/socom"
[ -z "$SOCOM" ] && [ -x "/Users/arinti-work/Documents/projs/socom/bin/socom" ] && SOCOM="/Users/arinti-work/Documents/projs/socom/bin/socom"
if [ -z "$SOCOM" ]; then
  echo "socom: tool not found — gate skipped locally, CI re-asserts. (export SOCOM_HOME=<socom checkout>)" >&2
  exit 0
fi
exec "$SOCOM" gate session-start
